unit: One model/stage cell, inspected in both inherited views and both central sections
required_text: notes: concrete visual evidence; do not infer legal topology or intersection counts from image
limits: No unique source style or exact source shape is used as the completion target
Section endpoints alone do not prove physical cracks
Small projected triangles do not automatically count as detached fragments
Uncertain or occluded appearance remains UNCERTAIN
Numerical connectivity and illegal-intersection evidence are reported separately
Rendering and numeric metric extraction never count as actual image review
assignment_policy: Original frozen eval_manifest order; contiguous 16 requests for root, training, eval

record_envelope.assertions: actually_viewed=true and views_and_sections_checked=true only after inspecting the actual image
record_envelope.files: Save actual observations as visual_review/review_<reviewer>[_part].json; no filled rating templates are created

completion_policy: Missing valid rows => INCOMPLETE; malformed, duplicate, unassigned or unauthenticated rows => validation error
